name: FPS Wave Defense (ba2adf62 baseline)
description: Replays the May-6→May-8 ba2adf62 case. Baseline: 28 snapshots, 1 validate_game_scene + 1 playtest_game across the whole arc, 93 set_todos calls, 5 render_preview calls, $26 of generation. Post-V2 must hold every Phase 9b cap.
brief: Create a simple 3D first-person shooter where the player fights through waves of enemies inside a building. Each final wave unlocks the exit and advances to the next level.
